__models.gap: docs/FORMATS.md §5 — "Every env object is empty across all scopes". On the reference machine settings.json's env held 3 CLAUDE_* feature toggles and nothing credential-shaped.
__models.standsInFor: ~/.claude/settings.json — settings-scope env, plus a pluginConfigs value that should have gone to the keychain
__models.sentinel: Every credential-shaped value contains the literal uppercase token SYNTHETIC. NO REAL CREDENTIAL IS PRESENT.

__shapeCaveats.pluginConfigs: UNVERIFIED — absent on the reference machine; nesting inferred from docs/02-architecture.md §4.2. See ../precedence/README.md.

__whyPluginConfigsSyncTokenIsAFinding: docs/02-architecture.md §4.2 declares `sync_token` as `sensitive: true`, which routes the value to the macOS Keychain or ~/.claude/.credentials.json. A literal value sitting in settings.json means that routing was bypassed — a finding in its own right, independent of the value's shape, and detectable by cross-referencing the plugin manifest's `userConfig`. `synthetic-clean@synthetic-market` is the paired control: same key, same position, correctly configured.
